741910201.text: Imperator, Imperator, are you alright? Are you dreaming again?

741910202.text: Ugh, so noisy. What's going on...

741910203.text: The people have gathered in your great hall. I believe they have questions for you, Imperator.

741910204.text: Recently, the melody of Phobos has been interrupted many times, and so they have many concerns regarding this.

741910205.text: I have no choice but to do this...

741910206.text: I trust your wise judgment, naturally, and I have heard something of the recent happenings... Is something wrong with Phobos?

741910207.text: Phobos has planned routes for everyone, such that humanity as a whole can attain happiness. There should be no issues, not when we have the aid of Sybilla's nearly limitless powers of calculation...

741910208.text: But I heard cries of sorrow within the music.

741910209.text: Did someone secretly alter the musical score of Phobos? No, none can do that except myself and the other Harmosts...

741910210.text: Could it be that the prophet had hidden something from us? Impossible. Has she not already sacrificed her very life for the cause? The veracity of her prophecy has been validated by the Mistress of Waters. She would have harbored no such selfish designs...

741910211.text: Or perhaps it is precisely because "she" had no desires of her own...

741910212.text: Today, all people rely on Phobos to make judgments and decisions for them. If something were to go wrong with it, the citizens fear that all would descend into chaos...

741910215.text: Is that to say you wish to separate my melody from the Grand Symphony as a contingency against mishaps?

741910216.text: No, no, it is still too early. I fear my soul is still unable to withstand such great fate...

741910298.text: "Defiled, defiled! Defiled are all who dwell in Capitolium! If blood will not wash this land clean, how shall guiltless flowers again bloom?"

741910299.text: "O you gods, shut tight the brass gates of the heavenly city! The sword of Remus has cut the threads of fate, and once land and sea alike have been conquered, all that shall remain is the path to the skies..."
